title: 第25章 收获第26章 暴露
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
“希望她能成长起来！”苏星河久久不愿收回视线。
“仙师！放虎归山，祸患无穷啊！”穆冠英似乎还未从先前的震惊中，回过神来，见苏星河放走了小姑娘，焦急提醒。
“我先前说的话，你没有听见？”苏星河面无表情的瞥了她一眼。
“可是魔修......”穆冠英还想再说，却被穆婉清轻轻拉动衣袖。
“好了，我需要休息下，你们自便！”苏星河话没说完，人已经迅速消失，速度之快，即使踏入修行的穆婉清二人，也只看到一道残影。
“仙师到底是什么修为？”穆婉清，呆呆的看着苏星河消失的方向。
“肯定不只是二层！”武大伟想起魔修老者提及过苏星河的修为。
“还好仙师实力足够强大，如果只是二层，不能将魔修斩杀，又使其暴露，我们恐怕会被灭口！”穆婉清想起魔修施展大血魄术吞噬苏星河气血时，强大的威压，心下仍是惊惧不已。
大战结束，残余灵力与血气散尽。
凶兽逐渐恢复过来，时而发出嘶吼，发泄着先前的惊恐。
远处总武头何晨光飞速赶来。
“见过家主！”
穆冠英点头，没有开口，神情凝重，仿佛在思考着什么。
“妖兽跑了？”
没看到妖兽尸体，只看到大片的血渍，何晨光面现担忧。
“解决了！”
几人表情各异，各自想着心事，只有武大伟勉强挤出一个微笑，回答何晨光。
“解决了就好！仙师呢？”
“已经回去休息了！”武大伟自从踏入炼气境，整个人的精神状态迅速恢复，再不似之前病秧子的样子，反倒是面色红润，气血充盈。
“晨光，这里交给你了！”

缓过神来的穆冠英吩咐一声，转身离开饲兽场，众人紧随其后。
客房中，苏星河再次服下一枚二次炼化的极品炼气丹，运转周天。
“这灵力经过炼化后，虽然足够精纯，但灵气含量，却依旧是中品丹药的含量，至于这下品炼气丹，灵力更是少的可怜。”
苏星河感叹一声，中品炼气丹需要一日炼化吸收，这下品丹药连半日都用不上，灵力含量可见一斑。
“还好突破到三层，不然这次真要阴沟翻船了！”苏星河感受这胸口的剧痛，以及周身上下的无力感，正是气血亏空的后遗症。
“这大血魄术当真诡异，竟然可以汲取别人精气，若是同等实力交手，体魄不如对方，又被近身缠上，结局恐怕只会与凶兽下场一样，全身精血被吸干，成为一具干尸。”
察觉到灵力汲取时，周身气血也在缓慢恢复，苏星河不再去理会，而是全部心思，都放在了这《大血魄术》之上。
按照大血魄术的描述，苏星河开始运转功法。
一周天后，察觉到气血恢复速度略微加快。
“这既然是魔修功法，以后使用时一定要小心，虽然宗门并未提及过关于魔修的忌讳，但自古仙魔不两立，一旦露出端倪，不免找来麻烦。
但这功法明显可以极大提高自身体魄，让修士拥有堪比妖兽的坚韧体魄，自然不能浪费，用来滋养体魄，还能再次提高实力！”
取出从魔修老者身上获取的储物袋，苏星河喜笑颜开，眼中更是充满期待。
“最好是多来点炼气丹！”苏星河存货不多，如今只剩下不到十枚，大半还都是下品炼气丹，真要一心修炼，十天都不够。
将物品全部取出，哗啦啦倒出一地，但苏星河的笑容确实凝固了。
content_en:
"I hope she can grow up!" Su Xinghe refused to look away for a long time.
"Master Immortal! If you let the tiger return to the mountain, there will be endless disasters!" Mu Guanying seemed to have not recovered from the previous shock. When she saw Su Xinghe letting the little girl go, she reminded him anxiously.
"Didn't you hear what I said before?" Su Xinghe glanced at her expressionlessly.
"But the demon cultivator..." Mu Guanying wanted to say more, but Mu Wanqing gently pulled her sleeve.
"Okay, I need to take a rest, you can help yourself!" Before Su Xinghe could finish his words, the person had quickly disappeared. The speed was so fast that even when Mu Wanqing entered the practice, they only saw an afterimage.
"What kind of cultivation is the Immortal Master?" Mu Wanqing stared blankly at the direction in which Su Xinghe disappeared.
"It's definitely not just the second floor!" Wu Dawei remembered that the old demon cultivator mentioned Su Xinghe's cultivation.
"Fortunately, the Immortal Master is strong enough. If we are only on the second level and cannot kill the demon cultivator and expose him, we may be wiped out!" Mu Wanqing was still frightened when she thought of the powerful pressure when the demon cultivator used the Great Blood Soul Technique to swallow Su Xinghe's blood.
The war is over, and the remaining spiritual power and blood are gone.
The ferocious beast gradually recovered, roaring from time to time, venting its previous fear.
He Chenguang, the commander-in-chief of the military force, came quickly from a distance.
"I've met the head of the family!"
Mu Guanying nodded without speaking, his expression solemn, as if he was thinking about something.
"The monster escaped?"
He Chenguang looked worried when he saw no corpse of the monster, only large blood stains.
"Solved!"
Several people had different expressions and each had their own thoughts. Only Wu Dawei forced out a smile and answered He Chenguang.
"Just solve it! Where is the Immortal Master?"
"I've gone back to rest!" Since Wu Dawei entered the Qi Refining Realm, his mental state has quickly recovered. He no longer looks like a sick man before, but his face is rosy and his Qi and blood are full.
"Chen Guang, I leave this place to you!"
After regaining his composure, Mu Guanying gave an order and turned around to leave the animal farm, with everyone following closely behind.
In the guest room, Su Xinghe once again took a second-refined top-quality Qi-refining pill and started to circulate around the world.
"After refining this spiritual power, although it is pure enough, the spiritual energy content is still that of a middle-grade pill. As for the low-grade Qi Refining Pill, the spiritual power is even less."
Su Xinghe sighed, the middle grade Qi Refining Pill needs a day to refine and absorb, but this lower grade pill doesn't even take half a day, which shows the spiritual power content.
"It's a good thing we broke through to the third level, otherwise we would have capsized this time!" Su Xinghe felt the sharp pain in his chest and the weakness all over his body, which were the sequelae of depletion of Qi and blood.
"This big blood soul technique is really weird. It can actually absorb the essence of others. If we fight with equal strength, but are not as strong as the opponent, and are caught close by, the ending will probably be the same as that of a ferocious beast. The essence and blood will be sucked out of the whole body and become a mummy."
When he noticed that the energy and blood all over his body was slowly recovering when he was absorbing spiritual power, Su Xinghe no longer paid attention to it, but focused all his attention on the "Great Blood Soul Technique".
According to the description of the Great Blood Soul Technique, Su Xinghe began to operate the technique.
A week later, I noticed that the recovery speed of Qi and blood was slightly accelerated.
"Since this is a demonic cultivation technique, you must be careful when using it in the future. Although the sect has not mentioned any taboos about demonic cultivation, since ancient times, immortals and demons have been incompatible. Once clues are revealed, it will inevitably cause trouble.
But this technique can obviously greatly improve one's own body, allowing monks to have a tough body comparable to monsters. Naturally, it cannot be wasted. It can be used to nourish the body and improve strength again! "
Taking out the storage bag obtained from the old demon cultivator, Su Xinghe beamed with joy, and his eyes were filled with anticipation.
"It's best to get more Qi Refining Pills!" Su Xinghe didn't have much in stock, and now he only had less than ten left, most of which were low-grade Qi Refining Pills. If he really wanted to focus on cultivation, even ten days wouldn't be enough.
Take out all the items and pour them outIt was all over the place, but Su Xinghe’s smile did solidify.
